headline: Going Commando reaches 7760 matched functions
summary: Going Commando integrated matching work across boot code and levels, including Yeedil and Aranos Prison. The day's final snapshot records 7760 of 8579 functions matched and about 84.7% of code by size. Matching means the recovered functions compile to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: A batch adds 453 matched boot and level functions (#384).
Regional matching work includes the lock-on tether family and two compiler fixes (#386).
Another batch matches 13 functions in Yeedil and Aranos Prison (#387).
